_comment: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo - text + lyrics to song. Export (API) format (2.741.0).
Tim: "yes please" (to adding ACE-Step) + "ace step can use loras".
Converted from ComfyUI's own template, Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
templates/audio_ace_step_1_5_split.json (the split-files version), with the
input NAMES from ComfyUI's source - comfy_extras/nodes_ace.py
(TextEncodeAceStepAudio1.5, EmptyAceStep1.5LatentAudio), nodes_model_advanced.py
(ModelSamplingAuraFlow), nodes_audio.py (SaveAudioAdvanced: format is a dynamic
combo, written as format + format.quality) and nodes.py (DualCLIPLoader type 'ace').
The two PrimitiveNodes of the template (seed 31, seconds 120) are inlined, as
ComfyUI's Export (API) does.
WHAT THE PATCHER FILLS IN (scripts/comfy_image.py):
lyrics         node 94 - the words. THE PROMPT.
tags           node 94 - the style's caption (genre, instruments, mood, vocal).
duration       node 94 (the encoder plans the song's length) AND 98 seconds
(the latent) - one number, both places.
bpm / keyscale / timesignature / language  node 94 - from the style when it
sets them; blank = this template's value.
seed           node 94 (the language model) and node 3 (the sampler).
steps / cfg / sampler / scheduler  node 3 - Turbo: 8 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple.
LoRAs          the style's LoRAs become LoraLoaderModelOnly nodes between
node 104 and node 78 (ACE-Step LoRAs patch the DiT, not the
Qwen text encoders).
model/te/vae   104 unet_name, 105 clip_name1 + clip_name2, 106 vae_name.
MODELS (Comfy-Org/ace_step_1.5_ComfyUI_files, split_files/ -> ComfyUI models/):
diffusion_models/acestep_v1.5_turbo.safetensors      (4.46 GB)
text_encoders/qwen_0.6b_ace15.safetensors            (1.11 GB)
text_encoders/qwen_1.7b_ace15.safetensors            (3.45 GB)
vae/ace_1.5_vae.safetensors                          (322 MB)
47 ConditioningZeroOut is the negative: the same text node, zeroed (the
patcher recognises this shape and never writes a negative prompt into it).
